q: The exam will start ___ 8 a.m. ___ Monday.
explain: Jam pada jam dinding pakai AT (at 8 a.m.), sedangkan nama hari pakai ON (on Monday). Dua satuan waktu berbeda, dua preposisi berbeda.

q: I was born ___ 2008, ___ July, ___ a Tuesday.
explain: Tahun (2008) dan bulan (July) sama-sama pakai IN karena periode panjang. Hari (a Tuesday) pakai ON.

q: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan preposition of time dengan BENAR?
opts: I always drink coffee at the morning.
We open presents on Christmas Day.
explain: "on Christmas Day" benar karena hari bernama khusus pakai ON. Seharusnya: "in the morning", "at night", "in 2007".

q: Let's meet ___ noon, right in front of the library.
explain: "noon" adalah titik waktu spesifik, sama seperti clock time, sehingga pakai AT.

q: Kenapa "night" memakai preposisi AT (at night), bukan IN seperti bagian hari lainnya?
opts: Karena "night" dianggap satu titik/blok waktu spesifik, bukan rentang waktu panjang seperti morning/afternoon/evening
Karena aturan tata bahasa mewajibkan semua kata bersuku kata satu memakai AT
Karena "night" tidak pernah muncul di kalimat formal
explain: Morning/afternoon/evening dianggap rentang waktu yang lebih panjang (pakai IN), sedangkan night dianggap satu blok waktu spesifik (pakai AT) — kecuali dipasangkan dengan hari spesifik, misalnya "on Friday night".

q: My father usually reads the newspaper ___ the afternoon, but ___ weekends he prefers to read ___ night.
explain: "the afternoon" (bagian hari) = IN, "weekends" (pola hari berulang) = ON, "night" (blok waktu spesifik) = AT.

q: The keys are ___ the drawer, and the drawer is ___ the second floor.
explain: "the drawer" adalah ruang tertutup → IN. "the second floor" adalah lantai gedung → ON.

q: Manakah kombinasi preposition of place yang BENAR?
explain: "on the table" benar (permukaan datar). Seharusnya: "on Jalan Sudirman" (nama jalan), "in Indonesia" (negara), "at the party" (acara/kegiatan).

q: Turn left ___ the traffic light, then the museum is ___ Asia's largest collection of ancient artifacts, located ___ the city center.
explain: "the traffic light" = titik spesifik → AT. "Asia" = benua → IN. "the city center" = wilayah/area → IN.

q: Kenapa "I'm on the bus" dianggap benar, padahal secara harfiah penumpang juga "di dalam" bus itu?
opts: Karena bus selalu terbuka di bagian atas
Kendaraan besar/umum (bus, train, plane, ship) memakai ON, sedangkan kendaraan kecil/pribadi (car, taxi) memakai IN — aturan ini harus dihafal per jenis kendaraan
Karena "on" dan "in" bisa dipakai bebas untuk transportasi apa saja
Karena bus dianggap sebagai permukaan datar seperti meja
explain: Ini pengecualian yang harus dihafal: in a car/taxi (kendaraan kecil), tapi on a bus/train/plane/ship/bike (kendaraan besar/umum atau yang dinaiki).

q: He is ___ school right now, but he'll be ___ home ___ 6 p.m.
explain: "at school" dan "at home" adalah frasa idiomatis yang fokus ke fungsi tempatnya, bukan bangunannya. "6 p.m." adalah jam spesifik → AT.

q: She walked ___ the room and jumped ___ the bed, while her cat jumped ___ the roof outside.
explain: "into the room" (masuk ke ruang tertutup) dan "onto the bed"/"onto the roof" (bergerak naik ke atas permukaan) sama-sama menunjukkan pergerakan, sehingga pakai into/onto, bukan in/on yang menunjukkan posisi diam.

q: We drove ___ the tunnel, then ___ the bridge that goes ___ the river.
explain: "through the tunnel" (melewati bagian dalam), "across the bridge" (dari satu sisi ke sisi lain), "along the river" (mengikuti garis memanjang sungai).

q: The train goes ___ Jakarta ___ Surabaya, passing several cities ___ the way.
explain: "from...to" menunjukkan titik awal-akhir perjalanan. "on the way" adalah frasa idiomatis (dalam perjalanan).

q: He ran ___ the stairs quickly, then walked ___ the hill slowly.
explain: "up the stairs" (bergerak naik) dan "down the hill" (bergerak turun) menunjukkan arah vertikal sepanjang sesuatu.

q: She walked ___ the exit, hoping to leave before the meeting ended.
explain: "towards" menunjukkan bergerak ke arah sesuatu, belum tentu sampai — cocok untuk konteks "menuju pintu keluar" tanpa memastikan sudah sampai.

q: Apa perbedaan utama antara "She jumped into the pool" dan "She is swimming in the pool"?
opts: Tidak ada perbedaan, keduanya sama persis
"into" menunjukkan aksi pergerakan masuk ke posisi baru, sedangkan "in" menunjukkan posisi diam yang sudah ada di situ
explain: into/onto = pergerakan menuju posisi baru; in/on = posisi diam yang sudah ada. "Jumped into" = aksi melompat masuk; "swimming in" = sudah di dalam, sedang berenang.

q: This novel was written ___ Andrea Hirata, and it was later adapted into a film ___ a famous director.
explain: Kedua kalimat pasif ini menunjukkan pelaku/agent (siapa yang menulis, siapa yang mengadaptasi) → keduanya pakai BY, bukan WITH.

q: The window was broken ___ the boy ___ a hammer.
explain: "by the boy" menunjukkan pelaku (agent), "with a hammer" menunjukkan alat (instrument) — dua preposisi berbeda bisa muncul sekaligus dalam satu kalimat pasif.

q: She cut the vegetables ___ a sharp knife before the soup was cooked ___ her mother.
explain: "with a sharp knife" = alat (instrument), "by her mother" = pelaku (agent) dalam klausa pasif.

q: I'm ___ your problems — you can always talk to me.
explain: "aware" pasangan tetapnya OF (aware of = sadar akan).

q: He's very ___ spiders, so he never goes near the garden shed.
explain: "afraid" pasangan tetapnya OF (afraid of = takut akan).

q: My parents are really ___ me for winning the competition.
explain: "proud" pasangan tetapnya OF (proud of = bangga akan).

q: I'm ___ waiting in this long queue — it's been an hour!
explain: "tired" pasangan tetapnya OF (tired of = bosan/lelah akan).

q: She's very ___ learning new languages — it's basically her hobby.
explain: "interested" pasangan tetapnya IN (interested in), bukan "to".

q: He's ___ maths but really ___ history.
explain: "good" dan "bad" (dalam konteks kemampuan/kepiawaian) pasangan tetapnya AT.

q: We were all ___ the sudden announcement.
explain: "surprised" pasangan tetapnya AT (surprised at = terkejut akan).

q: She's finally ___ her long-term boyfriend next month.
explain: "married" pasangan tetapnya TO — bukan "with", meski dalam Bahasa Indonesia kita bilang "menikah dengan".

q: This phone case is very ___ the one I lost last week.
explain: "similar" pasangan tetapnya TO (similar to = mirip dengan).

q: My little brother is ___ his phone — he can't put it down.
explain: "addicted" pasangan tetapnya TO (addicted to = kecanduan).

q: After living in Bogor for years, I'm finally ___ the rainy weather.
explain: "used to" (dalam konteks kebiasaan/terbiasa) pasangan tetapnya TO, diikuti kata benda atau gerund — beda dari "used to + V1" (dulu biasa).

q: We were very ___ the hotel service during our trip.
explain: "satisfied" pasangan tetapnya WITH (satisfied with = puas dengan).

q: This city is ___ its street food and traditional markets.
explain: "famous" pasangan tetapnya FOR (famous for = terkenal karena).

q: As the team leader, she's ___ the entire project's success.
explain: "responsible" pasangan tetapnya FOR (responsible for = bertanggung jawab atas).

q: This app's design is completely ___ the previous version — nothing looks the same.
explain: "different" pasangan tetapnya FROM (different from = berbeda dari) dalam Bahasa Inggris standar/formal.

q: He's really ___ his upcoming exam results.
explain: "worried" pasangan tetapnya ABOUT (worried about = khawatir tentang).

q: I always ___ music while I study.
explain: "listen" pasangan tetapnya TO (listen to = mendengarkan) — tidak bisa langsung diikuti objek tanpa preposisi.

q: This old bicycle ___ my grandfather.
explain: "belong" pasangan tetapnya TO (belong to = milik).

q: We finally ___ the airport after a very long flight.
explain: "arrive" tidak pernah diikuti "to" secara langsung — pakai AT untuk titik/lokasi spesifik seperti bandara, atau IN untuk kota/negara.

q: I'm currently ___ my missing wallet — have you seen it anywhere?
explain: "look for" = mencari. Beda dengan "look at" (melihat ke arah) dan "look after" (merawat/menjaga) — kata kerja yang sama, makna berbeda tergantung preposisinya.

q: It all ___ the weather — if it rains, the event will be cancelled.
explain: "depend" pasangan tetapnya selalu ON, tidak pernah "to".

q: You can always ___ your best friend when you need help.
explain: "rely" pasangan tetapnya ON (rely on = mengandalkan), sama seperti "depend on" dan "count on".

q: Please ___ your homework before you start playing games.
explain: "focus" pasangan tetapnya ON (focus on = fokus pada).

q: I really ___ you — I know you can do this.
explain: "believe" pasangan tetapnya IN (believe in = percaya akan keberadaan/nilai seseorang atau sesuatu).

q: This basketball team ___ five talented players.
explain: "consist" pasangan tetapnya OF (consist of = terdiri dari).

q: We need to ___ the budget before the meeting ends.
explain: "discuss" adalah kata kerja transitif dan TIDAK butuh preposisi tambahan — langsung diikuti objek. "Discuss about" adalah kesalahan klasik dari terjemahan langsung "membahas tentang".

q: Let's ___ the new marketing plan over lunch tomorrow.
explain: "talk" adalah kata kerja intransitif, jadi memang butuh "about" untuk memperkenalkan topiknya — beda dengan "discuss" yang transitif dan tidak butuh preposisi.

q: Manakah kalimat berikut yang menggunakan verb + preposition dengan BENAR?
opts: She always cares of her little sister.
They succeeded of finishing the marathon.
The team consists in five members.
explain: "apologize for" benar. Seharusnya: "cares for", "succeeded in", "consists of".

q: Can you please ___ this math problem ___ me? I really don't understand it.
explain: Pola "explain + [apa yang dijelaskan] + to + [orangnya]" — "explain me" (tanpa "to") adalah kesalahan klasik dari pola "jelaskan saya" dalam Bahasa Indonesia.

q: Identifikasi kesalahan pada kalimat: "He got married with a girl he met at university."
opts: Kalimatnya sudah benar, tidak ada kesalahan
"married with" seharusnya "married to" — hasil terjemahan langsung dari "menikah dengan"
explain: "married" selalu pasangan dengan TO, bukan WITH, meski dalam Bahasa Indonesia kita menerjemahkannya sebagai "menikah dengan".

q: Identifikasi kesalahan pada kalimat: "We arrived to the hotel very late last night."
opts: "arrived to" seharusnya "arrived at" (untuk lokasi/titik spesifik seperti hotel)
explain: "arrive" tidak pernah langsung diikuti "to". Untuk titik/lokasi spesifik seperti hotel/bandara/stasiun, pakai "arrive at".

q: Identifikasi kesalahan pada kalimat: "I'm interested to know more about your project."
opts: "interested to know" seharusnya "interested in knowing" — "interested" pasangan tetapnya IN, diikuti gerund
explain: "interested" selalu diikuti IN, bukan TO, dan kata kerja setelahnya harus bentuk -ing (gerund), bukan "to + V1".

q: Identifikasi kesalahan pada kalimat: "Whether the trip happens or not depends to the budget we have."
opts: "depends to" seharusnya "depends on" — "depend" tidak pernah dipasangkan dengan "to"
explain: "depend" pasangan tetapnya selalu ON. Kesalahan "depend to" muncul dari terjemahan langsung "tergantung kepada/pada".

q: Temukan kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan preposisi: "They discussed about the schedule, and then they agreed with the final decision."
opts: "discussed about" salah (harusnya tanpa "about"), "agreed with" sudah benar
"agreed with" salah (harusnya "agreed to"), "discussed about" sudah benar
Keduanya salah dan harus dihapus preposisinya
explain: "discuss" adalah verb transitif, tidak butuh "about". "agree with" (setuju dengan seseorang/pendapat) sudah benar sebagai pasangan tetap.

q: Baca paragraf berikut: "Rina is a university student who is good at painting. She's currently working on a project about Indonesian culture, and she's excited about presenting it next week. She's also grateful for her professor's support." Berdasarkan paragraf ini, preposisi apa yang tepat mengikuti kata "grateful"?
explain: "grateful" pasangan tetapnya FOR ketika diikuti hal yang disyukuri (grateful for her professor's support = bersyukur atas dukungan profesornya).

q: Dari paragraf pada soal sebelumnya, frasa "good at painting" menunjukkan pola dependent preposition untuk kategori apa?
explain: "good at" adalah pola adjective + preposition (AT) yang menunjukkan kemampuan/keahlian dalam sesuatu.

q: Manakah pasangan verb + preposition berikut yang artinya "merawat/menjaga", bukan "mencari" atau "melihat ke arah"?
explain: "look after" = merawat/menjaga. "look for" = mencari, "look at" = melihat ke arah — tiga makna berbeda dari kata kerja dasar yang sama tergantung preposisinya.

q: She ___ the missing report all morning but couldn't find it anywhere.
explain: "search for" = mencari secara menyeluruh, pasangan tetapnya FOR.

q: The heavy rain last week ___ severe flooding in several areas.
explain: "result in" = mengakibatkan (sebab → akibat). "result from" artinya kebalikannya (akibat → sebab), jadi konteks kalimat ini butuh "result in".

q: Don't ___ yourself ___ other people — everyone has their own journey.
explain: "compare... with" adalah pola verb + preposition standar untuk membandingkan dua hal/orang.

q: Manakah kalimat yang secara SEMUA preposisinya benar?
opts: She is famous for her paintings, and she's always proud of her students' progress.
She is famous of her paintings, and she's always proud at her students' progress.
She is famous with her paintings, and she's always proud to her students' progress.
She is famous at her paintings, and she's always proud with her students' progress.
explain: "famous for" dan "proud of" adalah pasangan tetap yang benar. Pilihan lain salah memasangkan kedua adjective dengan preposisi yang salah.

q: I'm ___ this software — I've used it for years at my old job.
explain: "familiar" pasangan tetapnya WITH (familiar with = akrab/paham dengan).

q: He ___ his mistake and apologized to everyone in the room.
explain: "ashamed" pasangan tetapnya OF (ashamed of = malu akan).
